post.summary: Permanently delete an app's on-disk state for a client
post.description: Force-removes the runner container backing any running session for this client/app pair and deletes its on-disk state folder from the host, regardless of whether a session is currently running. This is irreversible.
Update a client's settings including app state folder and client-specific settings
Pull a Docker image, will keep the connection open to send back progress updates. Each progress event will be a single line encoded as JSON.

post.summary: Execute a command in a running session's runner (container)
post.description: This endpoint executes a command inside the Docker container backing a running stream session, similar to `docker exec`. The response is a stream of newline-delimited JSON objects: zero or more RunnerExecOutputEvent chunks as output becomes available, followed by a final RunnerExecResponse with the exit code.
Freezes the runner's container (via Docker pause) and marks the session as paused. A paused session doesn't count towards its idle timeout.
Unfreezes the runner's container (via Docker unpause), clears the paused state and restarts the idle timeout countdown.

post.summary: Start a runner in a given session
Create a new stream session with custom configuration
post.description: This endpoint creates a stream session with full control over video/audio pipelines, runner configuration, and client settings. Use this for advanced session creation.

post.summary: Handle input for a stream session

client_id.description: The paired client whose app state should be removed

app_id.description: The app whose on-disk state should be removed

profile_id.description: The profile that originally created the lobby (optional, can be omitted when not using profiles)

pin.description: If present, the pin that is required to join the lobby.If this is not set, then the lobby is open to everyone

client_settings.description: Client settings to update (only specified fields will be updated)

pin.description: The PIN created by the remote Moonlight client

client_ip.description: The IP of the remote Moonlight client

session_id.description: The session ID whose running container the command will be executed in

command.description: The command to run, as argv (e.g. ["/bin/bash", "-c", "echo hi"])

user.description: The user to run the command as (optional, defaults to root)

stream.description: If true, the response is a stream of newline-delimited JSON: zero or more RunnerExecOutputEvent chunks followed by a final RunnerExecResponse. If false (default), the command runs to completion and a single RunnerExecResponse with the full output is returned.

output.description: Full combined stdout/stderr output. Only populated when streamed is false.

rtsp_fake_ip.description: RTSP fake IP for IP-less connections

idle_timeout_seconds.description: Idle timeout in seconds (optional, disabled if not provided)

video_producer_buffer_caps.description: Video producer buffer caps (optional, will use defaults if not provided)

h264_gst_pipeline.description: H264 GStreamer pipeline (optional, will use defaults if not provided)

hevc_gst_pipeline.description: HEVC GStreamer pipeline (optional, will use defaults if not provided)

av1_gst_pipeline.description: AV1 GStreamer pipeline (optional, will use defaults if not provided)

render_node.description: Render node (optional, will use defaults if not provided)

opus_gst_pipeline.description: Opus GStreamer pipeline (optional, will use defaults if not provided)

start_virtual_compositor.description: Start virtual compositor (optional, defaults to true)

start_audio_server.description: Start audio server (optional, defaults to true)

client_id.description: Client ID (optional, will create dummy client if not provided)

input_packet_hex.description: A HEX encoded Moonlight input packet, for the full format see: games-on-whales.github.io/wolf/stable/protocols/input-data.html

client_id.description: The client ID to identify the client (derived from certificate)

settings.description: Client settings to update (only specified fields will be updated)
